What differentiates

Every supported gradient is checked against finite differences. An unsupported one raises an error instead of returning zero; a zero means the physics never reads that input.

{{ c.counts.cells }} cells in tests/verification/test_gradient_matrix.py ({{ c.counts.direct }} on the direct solver, {{ c.counts.bddc_gmres }} repeated on BDDC + GMRES), each checked along 3 random directions against fourth-order central differences. Raises: test_gradient_matrix_raise_table.py.
